title: hear.ingest.batch.receipt.v1
description: Receipt for one hear.ingest.batch.v1 submission (application/vnd.dama.hear.ingest.batch-receipt.v1+json). counts.submitted equals accepted + duplicate + refused + deferred. A producer may release spooled items only through ack_through_index; items after it are not durable.

batch_schema_version.description: Frame major version this receipt answers.

batch_id.description: Echoed submitted batch_id, so a receipt is attributable without the body.

received_at.description: RFC3339 UTC instant the server accepted the bytes. Never a producer claim.

ack_through_index.description: Last item index made durable with no gap before it; -1 acknowledges nothing. A producer may release spool space only up to this index.

duplicate.description: Already durable under the same event_id. Success, not an error.

refused.description: Durably refused with a machine reason and retained raw bytes.

deferred.description: Not made durable. The producer must retry these.

counts.description: Conservation accounting. The four counts sum to the submitted item count.

index.description: Zero-based index in the submitted `messages` array.

status.description: Outcome for this item. Unknown members are preserved, never guessed.

event_id.description: Derived event identity when one could be derived, else null.

dispatchable.description: False for a stored record carrying an enum member this build does not know.

reasons.description: Machine reason codes. Empty for accepted and duplicate.

raw_ref.description: Object key of the retained original item bytes, or null when inlined.

classification.description: Item shape recognized by the frame reader: canonical envelope, or translation_required for a legacy telemetry body, or null.

results.description: Per-item outcome in submitted order, one entry per submitted item.

retry_after_s.description: Server-directed minimum delay before the next batch. Null means no direction; it is advice about load, never a substitute for client backoff.

envelope_major.description: Item envelope major this server supports.

server.description: Answering build, so a bad translation or a bad rollout is attributable.
